mechanism: Chlorthalidone causes hypokalemia and hyponatremia which can potentiate quetiapine's CNS effects and increase orthostatic hypotension; quetiapine may enhance thiazide-induced metabolic effects.
action: Monitor serum electrolytes regularly, blood pressure, and CNS symptoms; consider alternative antihypertensive if electrolyte disturbances develop; counsel on orthostatic precautions.
